name: Cursor
summary: A code editor with a built-in coding agent, a CLI and cloud agents.

skills.what: Agent Skills, the open standard, discovered from skill directories when Cursor starts.

mcp.what: MCP servers over stdio, SSE and Streamable HTTP, configured in mcp.json.

plugins.what: Plugins in the Agent Plugins open standard (root plugin.json) and in Cursor's own format (.cursor-plugin/plugin.json).

hooks.what: Hooks: scripts defined in hooks.json or installed through plugins that run before or after stages of the agent loop; Cursor can also load Claude Code hooks.

scheduled-work.what: Automations run cloud agents in the background on a schedule (preset or cron) or on events from GitHub, GitLab, Slack, webhooks, Linear and more.

sandboxes.what: The sandbox runs the agent's terminal commands in a restricted environment that blocks unauthorized file access and network activity; the Run Mode decides when commands enter it.
